svg.title: How the Shadewright Labs products fit together
svg.desc: The operator uses each product through one surface: a pull request review for Shadewright, sablectl and the web UI for Sablecourt, and the Nightloom view, which is not released. Shadewright's analyzer, executor, GitOps repository with Flux, and verifier form one chain; Sablecourt's control plane, Conclaves, managed workloads and three gates form another; Nightloom has one view and the decisions waiting. Two connections join the products. One: a one-way code-fault incident handoff from Shadewright to Sablecourt, approved by a person for each send; Sablecourt's intake is built and Shadewright's sender is planned. Two: a read-only observer feed from Sablecourt to Nightloom; Sablecourt's side is built and Nightloom's is not. Solid lines are built, dashed lines and tags are not built yet, and amber marks what a person decides.
